name: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
benefit:
**Financial Assistance For:** - Government Recognized Diploma Courses- ₹20,000/- - Postgraduate Diploma Courses- ₹25,000/-
> **NOTE:** Benefit applies to a maximum of two children and to the wife of registered male workers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra. 1. The applicant should be a child or spouse of a registered construction worker. 1. The construction worker should be registered under the MBOCWW. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government-recognized diploma or postgraduate diploma course.
